title: Filter extracted JSON array records
changes: Add cancellable case-insensitive filtering of direct field names and scalar values in JSON arrays, preserving source indices and returning to filtered results after opening a record.
Limit each scan to 10000 matches with an explicit notice, retain up to 20 array filters per selected file and keep list and table navigation available.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-json-filter-synthetic-9c6m4e88 checked both viewer modes, source indices, nested scope, cancellation, result bounds, file replacement and existing audio and navigation controls.

Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-json-filter-local-96wneefn checked all nine pages and a 376-record embedded catalog without changing embedded data. Docker unit rom-data-viewer-json-filter-docker-ft6e9rx4 matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: Filtering covers direct fields and scalar values only; numbers are searched after browser parsing and may lose precision. Structured JSON remains limited to 8 MiB and the paused large-file worker was not resumed. The source dataset volume was unavailable and native Windows was not tested.
